turns.replyTail:
f you want to start without a big investment, starting with single sample tiles or smaller accent projects is a great way to explore without overspending!
For affordable, highly popular patterns, options like our Rise 6"x7" Hexagon Floor & Wall Tile start at $10.00 for single sample tiles (or around $97.00 per box). Trying out a single sample tile lets you feel the quality, test the colors in your lighting, and practice with layout before committing to a larger order.
